texto.@es: Algunos 받침 escriben dos consonantes, aunque en posición final normalmente solo se oye una. En 읽다 se realiza ㄱ; ante vocal, en 읽어요, ㄱ se enlaza con 어 y ㄹ permanece como consonante final.
texto.@en: Some 받침 write two consonants, although in final position only one is usually heard. In 읽다 it is performed; before vocal, in 읽어요, it is linked with 어 and it remains as final consonant.
책을 읽어요= I read a book.
